Tutorial. In French.

At the [Rencontres R 2023](https://rr2023.sciencesconf.org/), Avignon, Wednesday, June 21, 2023, 10:00–12:00. An introduction to Quarto in three parts: what Quarto is, moving from R Markdown to Quarto, and Quarto projects. The site has the slides, the exercises and their solutions.
